inputs.label: 2026 proxy statement, record date share count
inputs.quote: We had 3,031,501,149 shares of common stock outstanding and entitled to vote on the record date, September 21, 2026.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: According to the records of our transfer agent, we had 6,219 stockholders of record as of May 31, 2026.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The denominator is the share count on the 2026 proxy's record date (September 21, 2026), the most recent stated count and the same one used in the marketcap lens; the Q1 FY2027 10-Q cover gives 3,023,736,000 at September 7, 2026.
